summary: Defines all storage-domain StrEnum constants: CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE (16 provider values), CONST_STORAGE_AUTH_METHOD, CONST_STORAGE_ACCESS_TYPE, CONST_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_TYPE, CONST_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STATUS, CONST_STORAGE_TRANSFER_MODE, CONST_STORAGE_COMPRESSION_TYPE. All include a case-insensitive find_member() classmethod via _FindMemberMixin.
extension_points: CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE enum must be extended to add new provider types
lifecycle_notes: Adding a new provider requires adding a member to CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE
documentation_hooks: CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE values are the discriminator keys for StorageFacade and the backend registry
risks: Removing or renaming an existing enum member is a breaking change

evidence.detail: Tests constant values and find_member behavior
